rationale: The existing stable renderer painted opening backgrounds separately from room floors. Unify their presentation coverage to prevent raster seams and independent opacity while preserving storage, area, symbols and physical semantics.

summary.ru: Пол комнаты непрерывно продолжается в проёмах, без отдельной цветной вставки.
summary.en: Room floors continue seamlessly into openings without a separate colored patch.
